confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 (peak summer and Mt Fuji season), not based on inspected booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) are the more reliable, since Japanese menu pricing is fairly stable. Accommodation anchors are low confidence because Fuji-view and peak-season premiums vary widely by date and property. Cocktail and wine_glass are not based on direct knowledge: both are set at about 1.4 times the beer anchor, the usual local relationship for bar drinks versus draught beer. The FX observation is the RBA figure dated 2026-10-15; a 2026-10-16 figure reported by a third-party site was not used because it could not be confirmed against the RBA.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Japanese mid-sized tourist resort towns in Yamanashi and the Fuji Five Lakes area, with Hakone and similar Kanto-region sightseeing towns as the closest reference points. Prices reflect typical ordinary venues in peak summer. Accommodation includes a seasonal uplift for Fuji views and July demand.
